definitions:
RECEIVING-YARDS PROPS vs THE MARKET: line accuracy, information test, and an early-snapshot betting backtest.

Stages (cache in scratch; holdout runs once, after output/research/props_frozen.json exists):
  python scripts/research/props_backtest.py prep      # match props -> games/players, model distributions, consensus
  python scripts/research/props_backtest.py dev       # 2023 only: info test fit, rule grid (prints, writes dev json)
  python scripts/research/props_backtest.py holdout   # 2024-25 ONCE with the frozen rules -> props_backtest.json

Data: data/historical_odds/props/player_reception_yds_{2023,2024,2025}.csv.gz (Odds API, regions=us), two snapshots per
event: "early" (Fri 21:40 UTC for Sunday games, kickoff-24h otherwise) and "close" (kickoff-75 min).
Model: scripts/research/props.py walk-forward GBM mean (train seasons < S) + conditional-empirical distribution
(400 nearest out-of-sample (mu, y) pairs from the previous 4 seasons, yards rescaled). "early" mode = teammate
availability from the final injury report (Out/Doubtful) only; "late" = actual actives.
Optimism in the early model (not removable here): recorded weather, nflverse CLOSING spread/total as features.

Market conventions:
  per-book no-vig P(over) = multiplicative (1/o)/(1/o+1/u);
  per-book location shift c_b = L_b - Q_S(1 - p_b): how far the model distribution S must be shifted so that it
  prices that book's line at the book's no-vig probability. Consensus shift c = median_b c_b (all us books).
  Market-implied distribution = S + c; blend(w) = S + (1-w)c (w=1 model, w=0 market).
  Consensus line L* = modal point across books (ties -> the one nearest the median point); p* = median no-vig P(over)
  among books at L*.
CLV of a bet at point L, side s, decimal d: P_close(s at L) * d - 1 where P_close is the median no-vig probability of
the close books quoting exactly L if any ("direct"), else the model distribution shifted to the close consensus
("shift"). Bets on players who did not play are void (no CLV, no PnL).

frozen.snapshot: early (Fri 21:40 UTC for Sunday games, kickoff-24h otherwise)
frozen.model: scripts/research/props.py GBM, mode=early (final injury report Out/Doubtful only), conditional-empirical distribution (400 NN, previous 4 seasons)

conventions.quotes: main-line only: both American prices in [-200, +170]
conventions.books_for_betting: my_books.json allowed_books present in the feed (draftkings, fanduel, betmgm, williamhill_us, betrivers; fanatics in 2025)
conventions.consensus: all us books in the feed (incl. betonlineag, bovada, unibet_us, pointsbetus, barstool)
conventions.blend: probabilities from model distribution S shifted by (1-w)*c_early, c_early = median over books of the shift making S price each book at its no-vig P(over)
conventions.selection: one bet per player-game: max EV over {over, under} x allowed books; bet if EV >= thr; flat 1 unit
conventions.clv: P_close(side at bet point)*decimal - 1; P_close = median close no-vig of books quoting the same point, else anchored: p*_close + K_OFF*(P_{S+c_close}(>L) - P_{S+c_close}(>L*_close))
conventions.void: player took no offensive snap -> no bet
conventions.pass_bar: mean CLV > 0 with one-sided game-clustered p < 0.05/3

rules.name: blend25_t03
rules.why: model+market blend; w=0.25 matches the 2023 logistic weight on the model (~0.25) and the location-regression slope (0.27). Dev 2023: n=588, CLV -3.75% (t -19.6), ROI +5.8% +/- 3.9%, 26.7 bets/wk.

rules.name: model_t12
rules.why: pure model, high threshold. Dev 2023: n=1012, CLV -4.4%, ROI +4.6% +/- 2.9%, 46 bets/wk (80% unders).

rules.name: shop_t02
rules.why: pure line shopping vs the all-book consensus (model only supplies the distribution shape for off-point prices). Dev 2023: n=146, CLV -1.95%, ROI -9.6% +/- 8.4%, 7 bets/wk. Best dev CLV among rules with >100 bets.

frozen.dev_verdict: No 2023 configuration with >=100 bets had CLV > 0. The close moves toward the model's side by 1-2.5 pp, which is less than the ~5% vig at the best allowed price. These rules are frozen to measure that out of sample, not because dev passed.
